notes.title: Update information
notes.notes:
Ichima-san version 1.1.1 has been released.
The changes are as follows:

[Additional Features]
・Added a mini-game resembling bowling.

[Bug Fixes]
・Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if you touched "Resume" immediately after selecting "Give up" or "Retry" during a mini-game while paused.
・Fixed a bug where enemies on the 2nd floor could capture the player on the 1st floor of the storehouse.
・Fixed an issue where jumping became impossible if the player moved away from an object while climbing.
・Fixed a bug where the character's eyes would not face the intended direction.
・Adjusted line breaks for hiragana text.
・Improved camera work during scene transitions in mini-games.
・Fixed an issue where the "Wake Up" command would trigger unintentionally for characters in the living room.

[Difficulty Adjustments]
・Adjusted the final battle so that hitting fallen Noh masks no longer causes damage.
・Modified the final battle to allow healing to recover up to the maximum value instead of stopping at a certain threshold.

notes.title: Update information
notes.notes:
Ichima-san version 1.0.9 has been released.
The changes are as follows:

Added options for resolution and fullscreen in settings.
Replaced several 3D models.
Added a few decorative objects.
[Bug Fixes]
┣・Fixed an issue in the final battle where the cursor would reset to the center of the screen when using mouse controls.
┣・Adjusted playtime limit to allow recording up to 999 hours; previously, the timer stopped at 9999 seconds (166:39.00).
┣・Fixed a bug where spirits could be collected at standing height even when crouching.
┣・Corrected a note timing issue in the rhythm game, where the input buffer was 0.5 seconds shorter than intended for some notes.
┗・Fixed an issue where restarting the game right after auto-saving upon paying to start fishing would cause money to be deducted without registering the fishing rod purchase.

[Improvements for Better Playability]
┣・Adjusted the layout of spirits in the detached building (total number of spirits has not changed).
┗・Adjusted collision detection for the rotary phone and copier in the study, allowing players to climb them."

notes.title: Update information
notes.notes:
We have released Ichima-san ver1.0.8.
- Fixed an issue where the game would not auto-save until it was saved once.
- Fixed the BGM to loop naturally.
- Adjustment of hit detection for sinks, etc.
- Addition and correction of hint text.
- Corrected the behavior of stickers to make them less likely to get caught.

notes.title: Update information
notes.notes:
We have released Ichima-san ver1.0.7.
- Fixed a bug where the number of game overs was twice the actual number.
- Fixed a bug where the date the adventure started was not saved correctly.
- About sound effects: Addition of sound effects ・Change some sound effects ・Adjust volume ・Remove noise
- Added a function to return to default values ​​in settings
- Various adjustments to events
- Added hint lines
- Object layout adjustment
- Changed the character's direction change behavior to be more natural.
- Corrected the behavior of enemy characters
- Fixed some UI layouts
- Fixed an issue where it was possible to move during an event in the storehouse.
- Fixed a bug where the camera's vertical and horizontal inversion settings were not reflected in the last battle.
- Adjustment of hit detection in the last battle
- Fixed a bug where if you select from the beginning when there is data from the continuation, the level and sticker progress will be initialized until you reset it.

notes.title: Update information
notes.notes:
We have released Ichima-san ver1.0.4.

- Fixed a bug where the irori in the library would sink into the ground.
- Installed a tarai in the annex.
- Fixed a bug where turning on the radio after a burglar leaves would produce voices of non-existent people.
- Corrected typographical errors.
- Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo version ver.0.1.6 has been released.
notes.notes:
Demo version ver.0.1.6 has been released.
The changes are as follows.

- Difficulty adjustment.
- Adjusted so that the hair is not messy.
- Changed first person view to look where the camera is just looking instead of where the doll is facing.
- When the game is over, you will now respawn at the position of the last candle you touched.
- Fixed an issue where the menu was difficult to operate with some controllers.
- Fixed an issue where spiritual power would recover when the menu was displayed.

notes.title: Demo version ver.0.1.5 has been released.
notes.notes:
Demo version ver.0.1.5 has been released.
The changes are as follows.

- Changed the opening performance.
- Fixed an issue where the character would jitter when pressing the jump button while speaking.
- Fixed an issue where the range in which you could talk to Kokeshi dolls was narrow and it was difficult to talk to them.
- Added more kokeshi dolls that give hints.
- Reduced the size of stage 1.

notes.title: Demo version has started distribution
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44381865/507807c3f841f0992c8ff94ceb5d80d2e788eb3a.png

The demo version has started distribution.
In the demo version, you can experience up to the middle of stage 1.

From now on, we plan to make improvements to make it easier to play by eliminating unfriendly parts and parts that are slow to operate.

The demo version will also be updated regularly.

I plan to add 4 stages to the product version.

There are 3 or 4 missions for each stage, and I'm planning to make it possible to progress to the ending without clearing all the missions.

I plan to enhance the game's power without changing the part of the game where you search for items based on hints and expand your range of action.

I created a Discord server for the game "Ichima-san".
https://discord.gg/p8xwHUE8Mj

If you find any bugs, please let us know on Discord
